== Biography ==
Rachel Glasgow was born on 8 November 1738 in County Antrim, Ireland, a daughter of [[Glasgow-1143|Robert Glasgow]] and [[Wilson-78088|Rachel Wilson]].<ref name="KilwaughterRegister">[https://web.archive.org/web/20101124184247id_/http://lifesweaving.com/Glasgow/Kilwaughter/Timeline.html Archived Kilwaughter chronology], transcription derived from PRONI MIC/1B/6, recording Rachel born 8 November 1738 to Robert and Rachel Glasgow.</ref>

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1143]] is assessed at 98% (proved). The derivative congregation chronology explicitly records Rachel born 8 November 1738 to Robert and Rachel. Deed/equity context identifies this adult Robert household; omission among the 1742 survivors concerns survival, not fatherhood.

Named child to the specific adult family role represented by the selected father; independent earlier ancestry is outside this assessment.

An 1817 equity complaint states that Rachel Wilson died in 1742 leaving James and Ann.<ref name="Equity1817">[https://web.archive.org/web/20101124184247id_/http://www.lifesweaving.com/Glasgow/Paper_Complaint.html 1817 equity complaint transcription], stating that Rachel Glasgow died in 1742 leaving James and Ann.</ref> The omission suggests that this younger Rachel died before 1742 or was omitted from the later pleading; no death record has yet been identified.
